text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Environment Preparation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup-environment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Prepare Copilot environment
        id: copilot-setup
        uses: github/gh-aw/actions/setup@32b3a711a9ee97d38e3989c90af0385aff0066a7
        with:
          destination: .copilot-env

      - name: Use Copilot environment
        env:
          COPILOT_ENV_DIR: ${{ steps.copilot-setup.outputs.files-copied }}
        run: |
          echo "Using Copilot environment at $COPILOT_ENV_DIR"
          # Add any additional commands to use the Copilot environment here

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
```

This workflow sets up a basic GitHub Actions pipeline for the `microsoft/griffel` repository. It includes steps to check out the repository, set up Node.js, install dependencies, prepare the Copilot environment, and run tests. The Copilot environment is prepared using the `github/gh-aw/actions/setup` action, which copies activation job files to the agent environment. You can customize this workflow further based on your specific requirements.
